description: 象腾挪c5，清开斜线让后将杀
explanation_en: The bishop moves with check to clear c5 from the queen's diagonal, allowing Qa7#.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：白象在c5，挡住了白后d4→a7的斜线通路。如何让后走到a7将杀？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: White's bishop on c5 blocks the queen's diagonal from d4 to a7. How can White clear the route for Qa7#?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bd6+！象腾挪离开c5，清开d4-a7斜线——Qa7#绝杀！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bd6+ clears the bishop from c5 and opens the d4-a7 diagonal for Qa7#.

moves.popup: 白象Bd6+！腾挪离开c5，清开d4→c5→b6→a7斜线，同时将军！
moves.popup_en: White plays Bd6+, moving the bishop off c5 to clear the d4-c5-b6-a7 diagonal while giving check.

moves.popup: 黑兵被迫exd6——c5已清空，斜线通了！
moves.popup_en: Black is forced to capture with exd6. The bishop has cleared c5 and opened the diagonal.

moves.popup: 白后Qa7将杀！腾挪清路——一击制胜！
moves.popup_en: Qa7# is checkmate! The clearance opened the route for the decisive queen move.
